positions.summary: In October 2023 Reconquête attacked the RN for opposing the requirement of about 15 hours of activity for RSA recipients, presenting itself as the only party against 'assistanat'. That implies support for keeping the obligation.

sources.quote: Reconquête revendique être « les seuls » à refuser l'assistanat.

positions.nuance: This is a party position, voiced by Marion Maréchal's team, who has since left Reconquête. No personal statement by Zemmour was found. In 2026 Sarah Knafo said 'il n'y a pas d'assistés en France' and blamed the system, which may soften the anti-assistanat framing. No sign Reconquête wants to abolish the obligation.

positions.summary: The 2022 programme planned to make naturalisation harder, end birthright citizenship (droit du sol) and strip binational offenders of nationality. That is the opposite of easier naturalisation.

sources.quote: Éric Zemmour envisage de durcir les conditions de naturalisation et d'interdire la régularisation d'une personne entrée illégalement
l'arrêt de l'immigration, la suppression du droit du sol, la fin du regroupement familial ou encore la préférence nationale

positions.nuance: Based on the 2022 programme, since no 2025-2026 statement specifically on naturalisation was found. The 'zero immigration' line has not changed since.

positions.summary: Zemmour wants French defence autonomy and opposes an integrated European defence, which he says would put France under the European Commission. His 2022 defence programme rejects 'fédéralisme européen' and planned to leave NATO integrated command to regain 'pleine indépendance'.

sources.quote: Paraphrase: il a souligné la nécessité d'une autonomie de défense pour la France et exprimé son opposition à une défense européenne intégrée
ni le multilatéralisme donneur de leçons ni le fédéralisme européen n'ont apporté les bonnes réponses aux désordres du monde

positions.nuance: The 2024 CNews statement is known only through a fact-checker's paraphrase. The programme is from 2022. No 2025-2026 statement on joint arms procurement specifically was found.

positions.summary: The 2022 Europe programme pledged to refuse any new EU enlargement. That covers Ukraine's accession.

sources.quote: Refuser tout nouvel élargissement et mettre fin au processus d'adhésion de la Turquie

positions.nuance: The programme was published in January 2022, before Ukraine applied (February 2022) and became a candidate. It is a general refusal of enlargement and does not name Ukraine. No 2025-2026 statement by Zemmour on Ukrainian accession was found. He opposed arms deliveries and sanctions in 2022.

positions.summary: No statement found supporting or opposing guaranteed minimum (floor) prices for farmers.
positions.nuance: The 2022 agriculture programme relied on ending joint purchasing groups, short supply chains, import bans and opting out of free-trade talks, with no floor prices. In January 2026 he said he supported protesting farmers, but nothing on prix planchers. Stays null.

positions.summary: No Zemmour proposal found to cut VAT on energy and fuel to 5.5%.
positions.nuance: The 5.5% energy-VAT proposal found in search belongs to Marine Le Pen and the RN. Zemmour's 2022 energy, automobilistes and purchasing-power sheets offer other measures (replacing ARENH, employers covering 50% of fuel costs) and no VAT cut. Stays null.

positions.summary: The 2022 programme pledged to abolish the licence fee by privatising the main public broadcasting channels. Zemmour named France Inter and France Télévisions in December 2021, and Reconquête kept calling for privatisation in 2025.

sources.quote: Supprimer la redevance audiovisuelle (138€/foyer) grâce à la privatisation des principales chaînes de l'audiovisuel public
il ajoute le 15 décembre 2021 qu'il souhaite privatiser, « en particulier France Inter et France Télévisions »
l'eurodéputée Reconquête dresse un constat implacable : face aux multiples dysfonctionnements, il est plus que jamais temps de privatiser

positions.nuance: The 2021-2022 plan (L'Opinion) would hand France 3 and France Bleu to the regions and privatise France 2, franceinfo TV, France Inter, Mouv and FIP, so partial but substantial privatisation. That matches 'tout ou partie'. The 2025 evidence is Sarah Knafo (party line).

positions.summary: Zemmour told franceinfo he will promise in the campaign to repeal the 2026 assisted-dying law.

sources.quote: J'abrogerai cette loi qui met fin à tous les garde-fous pour investir dans le soin et le progrès médical

positions.nuance: An explicit repeal promise made after the law was adopted on 15 July 2026. In May 2025 he called it 'une espèce de rétablissement de la peine de mort qui ne dit pas son nom' (CNews headline).

positions.summary: The 2022 programme banned the Islamic veil in all public space, and in 2025 Zemmour said it must be banned 'partout'. That covers parents accompanying school trips.

sources.quote: Interdire le port du voile islamique dans l'espace public
Si ça nous déplait dans ces endroits là, cela veut dire qu'il faut l'interdire partout.

positions.nuance: No statement names school-trip parents specifically. A general public-space ban would include them, so the code is inferred from the broader rule. The measure targets the Islamic veil, not all conspicuous religious symbols.

positions.summary: The 2022 programme banned the Islamic veil in all public space. In May 2025 Zemmour cited the debate on banning it at universities and said it must be banned everywhere.

sources.quote: Interdire le port du voile islamique dans l'espace public
il y a des débats qui disent il faut interdire dans le sport ou dans les universités. Si ça nous déplait dans ces endroits là, cela veut dire qu'il faut l'interdire partout.

positions.nuance: Targets the Islamic veil specifically, not all conspicuous symbols. Les Surligneurs (2025-03-27) also reports him calling for 'discrétion dans l'espace public'.

positions.summary: No statement found on ending selection for university entry.
positions.nuance: Searches on Parcoursup or selection plus Zemmour turned up nothing usable. His general stance favours merit and authority, which makes support for ending selection unlikely, but there is no direct evidence, so it stays null.
